magnetRadius.label: Loot Magnet Radius (Cells)
magnetRadius.description: Maximum grid-cell radius around the player for filter-aware Loot Magnet relocation (server-clamped to 80).

pickupRadius.label: AoE Pickup Radius (Cells)
pickupRadius.description: Maximum grid-cell radius around the player for filter-aware AoE Pickup (server-clamped to 80).

mergeRadius.label: Loot Merger Radius (Cells)
mergeRadius.description: Maximum grid-cell radius around the player for ground stack merging (server-clamped to 80).

maxBatchSize.label: Max Entities Per Trigger
maxBatchSize.description: Hard server-enforced cap on ground item entities processed per RPC trigger.

autoMergeEnabled.label: Auto-Merge Nearby Stacks
autoMergeEnabled.description: Automatically merges nearby compatible ground stacks on a throttled area tick.

autoMergeIntervalSeconds.label: Auto-Merge Tick Interval (Seconds)
autoMergeIntervalSeconds.description: Minimum elapsed seconds between automatic ground stack merge passes.

scopeMergeToFilter.label: Scope Manual Merge To Filter-Visible Items
scopeMergeToFilter.description: When true, manual Loot Merge only merges stackables currently visible under the client's active item filter.

zoomOverrideEnabled.label: Enable Camera Zoom Override
zoomOverrideEnabled.description: Applies a custom camera zoom override via ICameraService (automatically restored to stock on unload).

zoomOverrideValue.label: Camera Zoom Override Factor
zoomOverrideValue.description: Camera zoom factor written to CameraController when Camera Zoom Override is enabled.
